thread:
service-monitor-bot: ALERT: spike in 502/gateway errors from us-west1 -> 2.6% error rate over last 5m, traces show upstream prefix-kv timeouts and 502s. Rolling windows show increased cache miss rate and eviction spikes. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/incidents/1768554321 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Severity: P1 auto-pager triggered. Pager: @Aisha (oncall-sre). CC: @Ravi @Liam. Runbook: prefix-kv > live mitigation.
Aisha: on it. looking at gateway logs now. grabbing tail.
Aisha: `curl -v "https://api.redwood.test/v1/health"` shows gateway 502 intermittently.
Ravi: I'm seeing repeated logs: `prefix-kv: shard=7 eviction=true miss=1 checksum_err=1` — could be corruption or bad prefetch.
Liam: can you paste the exact error lines?
Aisha: paste logs: ```ERROR prefix-kv shard=7 key_prefix=usr: checksum mismatch read=0x4a3f expected=0x1c9b; fallback to upstream = false; returning 502```
Maya: @Aisha what's the percent of traffic hitting that shard? any customer complaints?
Aisha: ~3% of overall RPS hits that shard. Support pinged: 4 customers reporting failures in last 8m, one customer (acme-corp) trying retries -> visible UIs failing.
Ravi: initial hypothesis: a corrupted cache object got served, causing fetches to fail and cascade to upstream timeouts due to blocking fetches. eviction storm on adjacent shards causing IO pressure.
Sando (eng): any recent deploys to prefix-kv or prefetch service?
Aisha: No full deploys in last 12h. There was a config flip on prefetch policy earlier today (enable aggressive prefetch=true) — rolling config at 15:03 UTC.
Liam: can you run quick health checks on prefix-kv pods and prefetch workers? `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=prefix-kv -o wide`
Aisha: output: ```pod/prefix-kv-7b6d READY 1/1 STATUS Running RESTARTS 0 AGE 14d
pod/prefix-kv-7b6e READY 1/1 STATUS Running RESTARTS 0 AGE 1h
pod/prefix-kv-7b6f READY 1/1 STATUS Running RESTARTS 6 AGE 2h
...```
Ravi: restarts on one pod + eviction spikes -> may be thrashing. Check disk I/O and kernel OOM logs on those hosts.
Aisha: `dmesg` shows no OOM. iostat shows high write latency on node-7 (~200ms).
Maya: this smells like prefetch + cache eviction loop. Suggest short-term: enable cache-bypass for gateway for reads to reduce pressure and fall back to origin store for affected prefixes.
Liam: agree — toggle feature flag `prefix_cache_bypass=on` for us-west1 only. That will increase downstream origin load but should reduce cache pressure.
Aisha: rolling bypass for us-west1 now (canary 5%). will monitor errors/latency.
incident-bot: Action recorded: feature-flag-toggle by Aisha at 1768554510.
Aisha: canary done -> increased to 25% after 2m, errors dropped from 2.6% -> 1.1%. latency to origin increased but still within SLO for most customers.
Ravi: good. next: need to identify root cause for corruption. Are checksums verified at write time? any recent quantized model or serialization change?
Sando (eng): we shipped a change to prefetch serializer 6h ago that included a new compression codec in a behind-flag path. Might be related.
Maya: can we reproduce a checksum mismatch locally? capture a sample key that fails.
Aisha: capturing failing key examples: `usr:42719:kv-meta`. Trying `redis-cli --rdbdump` on local replica gives some reads but checksum recompute fails.
Liam: run quick verification job: `python tools/prefetch_verify.py --shard 7 --limit 1000` and check output.
Aisha: verification shows ~2/1000 mismatches; pattern: smaller object sizes compressed with codec v2.
Ravi: ok that indicates serializer bug causing corrupt entries. Mitigation plan: 1) keep bypass enabled for us-west1 2) roll back prefetch serializer flag to previous codec 3) invalidate affected prefix shard objects (careful) 4) schedule controlled delete/invalidate job to avoid eviction storms.
Maya: we should avoid mass invalidation that triggers eviction surge. Use staged invalidation with backoff and rate-limit.
Aisha: starting rollback of serializer flag now. `fluxctl rollback --resource prefetch-config --to-revision stable`
incident-bot: Deploy rollback started by Aisha at 1768554712.
Aisha: rollback complete at 1768554830. Monitoring.
Ravi: while rollback settles, start a targeted clean job: `delete-keys --shard 7 --prefix "usr:" --rate=50/s --verify=true` — run on single pod first.
Liam: approve run, keep traffic bypass until deletion completes.
Aisha: running deletion on one pod now. logs: `deleted 1.2k keys, revalidated 98% checksums passed`
Maya: how's customer impact? Support: acme-corp reports decreased errors after bypass. keep them updated.
Aisha: updating status page: "Investigating elevated 502s in us-west1; mitigation in progress. Some customers may see increased latency while we bypass cache."
incident-bot: Status update posted to incident timeline at 1768555120.
Ravi: after deletion and rollback, monitor for eviction spikes. If eviction rate > baseline * 3, throttle invalidation.
Aisha: deletion completed across shard 7 at 1768555920. Final stats: 4.8k keys invalidated, peak RPS to origin +18%, errors down to 0.3%.
Liam: run a full scan on other shards for same pattern (codec v2). `prefetch_verify --all-shards --sample=100` scheduled.
Maya: next steps: post-incident checklist: 1) postmortem timeline 2) revert temporary bypass when safe 3) add pre-write checksum validation for serializer path 4) add monitoring alert for serializer flag flips 5) coordinate customer outreach.
Aisha: will hand off to @Ravi for postmortem and timeline followup. I'm leaving oncall in 20m.
Ravi: taking handoff. Thanks @Aisha for rapid mitigation. I'll coordinate RCA and customer comms.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall -> Ravi at 1768556800. Pager cleared for Aisha.
Maya: quick note for ops: add a gradual invalidation controller to avoid eviction storms (rate cap, backoff, health-check).
Ravi: noted. I'll create ticket and tag eng-prefetch/infra.
Sando (eng): thanks team. Any remaining hotspots?
Aisha: us-west1 error rate stable at 0.2% now. closing live mitigation.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. P1 -> active -> mitigated. Postmortem owner: Ravi.
Ravi: will set timeline + distribute to stakeholders. If anyone has raw logs or sample corrupt keys, DM me. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
